Fewest weather stress events (dry pre-planting windows and years with heavy rain on bare soil): 0.8 on average vs 1.0 for What I do now.

field_conditions.text: Typical conditions per calendar month from this field's NASA POWER cell (~50 km): modeled soil wetness (0 = dry, 1 = saturated), rain and air temperature. Median and the 1-in-10 low and high across the record.

climate_adjustment.note: The trend observed in this field's own record, carried forward to the middle of the outlook. Rain in every replayed season is rescaled by it when the trend is statistically clear; temperature is reported as context only.
climate_adjustment.text: No statistically clear trend in yearly rain at this field since 1981 (about -1.1% per decade, within normal year-to-year variation), so rain is used as recorded. Temperature has risen about 0.45 C per decade; it is shown as context and does not change the results.

method.draws: Every scenario replays the same sequence of past seasons in each run, so differences come from the plans, not from the draw.
method.measurement_note: Your compatible measurements replace estimates on their recorded dates. Other dates use the regional record. Soil temperature and VWC are kept in their own units.
method.note: An evidence-based outlook: this field's real past seasons (1981-2025) replayed in new orders over the next 5 seasons. It shows what to plan for under conditions seen here; it cannot say what any single year will bring.
method.resolution: One NASA POWER cell (~0.5 x 0.625 degrees): fields in one cell share one weather series.
